subject: Internal alignment: MAP launch checklist for Acme evaluation
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Internal alignment: MAP launch checklist for Acme evaluation

Team —

Quick internal note before we run the customer kickoff next week (tentatively Wed 11/18): I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) and a short evaluation checklist (spreadsheet) focused on the timelines Acme shared during discovery. Goal for our pre-kickoff: agree RACI, lock the first two milestones (POC access & performance eval window), and confirm who owns procurement/legal touchpoints.

Ask: please review the attached redwood_map_draft_v1.docx and the evaluation_plan_checklist.xlsx and reply with the following by EOD Monday (11/16):
- Confirm R (Responsible) and A (Accountable) for milestones 1–4 in the doc (I called them Access, Baseline, Quality, Procurement).
- Flag any blockers (security evidence, test data, region constraints).
- Suggest 45-min pre-kickoff time slots (I'm proposing Mon 11/16 10:30–11:15 PT or 3:00–3:45 PT).

Notes in the doc are rough — I intentionally left procurement items slightly vague until we align. We'll finalize before I share externally with Olivia.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.docx (MAP draft, comments enabled), evaluation_plan_checklist.xlsx (milestone timeline + owner columns)

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal alignment: MAP launch checklist for Acme evaluation

Thanks Steph — quick notes while I review the doc:
- I'll take R for milestone 1 (Provision POC and credentials) and A for baseline infra validation — I can own the test VM setup and short perf smoke tests.
- We should add a security evidence column linking to our SOC2/pen test pack and note any data residency asks (Acme mentioned EU customers, but they said US-first for phase 1).
- Procurement: Jordan should be the primary for pricing/term negotiations; if we need contract redlines we'll loop in Rachel from Legal (I can reach out once Jordan confirms).

Availability: Mon 11/16 10:30 PT works for me.

- Dev

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal alignment: MAP launch checklist for Acme evaluation

Adding a quick RACI sketch inline — happy to refine in the pre-kickoff: 

Milestone 1 — POC access & credentials- R: Dev Patel- A: Stephanie Nguyen- C: Grace O'Connor- I: Jordan Blake

Milestone 2 — Baseline performance validation (latency and throughput checks)- R: Dev Patel- A: Jordan Blake- C: Stephanie Nguyen- I: Grace O'Connor

Milestone 3 — Quality eval (sample prompts, regression checks)- R: Grace O'Connor- A: Jordan Blake- C: Stephanie Nguyen- I: Dev Patel

Milestone 4 — Procurement & contract signoff- R: Jordan Blake- A: Jordan Blake- C: Stephanie Nguyen, Dev Patel- I: Legal (Rachel Kim)

Jordan

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal alignment: MAP launch checklist for Acme evaluation

Thanks — I like Jordan's RACI, a few additions from PM/QA perspective:
- Add a "Success criteria" column to milestone 3: target F1 > 0.82 on their eval set and no quality regressions vs baseline prompts.
- I'll prep the sample prompt set (10 examples) and a short eval harness (notebook) and drop in the Drive folder by EOD today.
- Pre-kickoff agenda (45 mins): 1) Introductions & goals (5m) 2) RACI review (10m) 3) Timeline & milestones (10m) 4) Test data & success criteria (10m) 5) Next steps/owner confirmations (10m).

Confirming Mon 11/16 10:30–11:15 PT for pre-kickoff. Steph — can you book the calendar and include Olivia's calendar (I'll add the Drive link when ready)?

Grace
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Martin <olivia.martin@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Acme MAP & evaluation plan (finalized internal alignment)

Hi Olivia — following our internal alignment, attached is the Mutual Action Plan and the evaluation checklist we plan to use for the Acme POC. Key dates:
- POC access provisioned: target 11/20
- Baseline performance window: 11/23–11/27
- Quality evaluation & decision window: 11/30–12/04

Owners (internal):
- POC/infra: Dev Patel (dev_patel@redwood.com)
- Performance & eval orchestration: Jordan Blake (jordan_blake@redwood.com)
- Quality/pm: Grace O'Connor (grace_oconnor@redwood.com)

Next steps for Acme: please confirm the following by EOD Thursday 11/19 so we can hit the above timeline:
1) Provide test dataset snippet (5–10 prompts) or confirm we can use Redwood sample set.
2) Confirm the contact for procurement/questions on invoicing.

Attachments: redwood_map_draft_v1.docx (finalized internal copy), evaluation_plan_checklist.xlsx

If anything looks off on our side, flag back and we'll adjust — otherwise we'll treat these milestones as our mutual plan and kick off access provisioning on Friday.

Thanks — looking forward to the POC.

Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0198
